gen-gf-turret-road-gf-pridi: Pridi stands tall, its small letters nearly as big as capitals, with curves that leave generous room by the stem. Pridi's size is the thing to nudge up or down, while Turret Road, bold and pen-like with round parenthesis forms, holds its own at any size.
gen-gf-twinkle-star-fs-bespoke-sans: Twinkle Star's tightly packed, pen-and-paper letters give it a casual, graceful hand, with curves that open outward. And Bespoke Sans, a plain sans with sharp lines and roomy curve openings, is comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-epunda-slab: Stout, stubborn, horseshoe-mouthed. Epunda Slab follows in a dignified voice, its tall rounded lowercase and gaping c giving the text room, while Underdog's pipe-cleaner strokes handle the loud talking.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-fauna-one: Big, blunt, horseshoe-curved. Fauna One then settles in as a literary serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, while Underdog earns its keep when set large and short.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noticia-text: Underdog draws every stroke with steady pressure, bold and unbroken. Noticia Text, a dignified serif with tall lowercase bodies and wide entrances into its curves, supplies the quiet counterweight that makes the loud heading feel intentional.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-piazzolla: Chunky, wide-mouthed, unmistakably loud. Underdog's heavy diagonals sit above Piazzolla, a serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose open e keeps long paragraphs moving with an authoritative, easy stride.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-scope-one: Underdog's strokes never change weight. Scope One, a text serif with spilling counters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, gives the page a traditional, refined floor under that bent-tubing heading.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-suwannaphum: Underdog's line never thins or swells, and its c gapes like a horseshoe. Suwannaphum, a dignified serif with a high, squared-off x-height and a c as open as a bent paperclip, carries a longer read with editorial ease.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: Wide-eyed and unmistakably bold. Padyakke Expanded One sprawls its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, so a little extra size on the body would let that serif breathe beside Unica One.
gen-gf-unifrakturcook-fs-rowan: Dense, dark, and fiercely blackletter. Make UnifrakturCook small and its packed line turns hard to read, or make Rowan large and the friendly classic serif loses its quiet, literary manner.
